xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4320: Dashboard serves every Herdr agent as stopped: event-driven pane inventory never records agentId

plan.title: Dashboard serves every Herdr agent as stopped: event-driven pane inventory never records agentId
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: On the Herdr backend the dashboard serves every managed agent as stopped. GET /api/agents returned 86 rows, all stopped/exited, while herdr agent list showed live agent panes with agentId tokens. The /ws/rpc snapshot carried those panes with agentId, but the 14 agents started after dashboard boot were missing from agentsById entirely. Root cause: six server sites join an agent id to a BackendPane by `pane.terminalId ?? pane.id`, which on Herdr are backend handles (`term_…`, `wKZ:p3`), never agent ids, violating the documented rule in docs/TERMINAL-BACKENDS.md. Because Herdr work agents run without the PTY supervisor, the enrichment poller's agent.created is the only way a post-boot agent enters agentsById, and that poller filters by the wrong key. Secondary defects: the Herdr event path (pane-created, metadata) drops agentId and the real terminalId until the next 5 s list refresh, and the enrichment poller skips every cycle on a Herdr host with no tmux server.
narratives.Proposal: Add paneAgentKey(pane) = agentId ?? terminalId ?? id and indexPanesByAgentKey(panes) (non-exited pane wins a key collision) to packages/contracts/src/backend-pane.ts. Move every violating join onto it: routes/agents/listing.ts (GET /api/agents and /tmux-alive), agent-enrichment-service.ts livePaneIds, agent-state-service.ts runtime seed, agent-projection.ts paneAlreadyExited, resource-refresh-triggers.ts issueForAgent. Make the Herdr pane-created and metadata events carry agentId (via agentIdOf, the list() rule) and pane-created carry terminalId; BackendPaneCache.apply records them. Make shouldSkipEnrichmentCycle follow the host backend policy: under Herdr skip only while the backend inventory is degraded. Update docs/DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/TERMINAL-BACKENDS.md. Verify live on a peer dashboard (port 3497) and record the probe in the PR.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Changing deriveServedAgentStatuses() in src/dashboard/server/read-model.ts (it already matches pane.agentId)
- Any frontend change, including src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/GodView/confluence/liveness.ts
- Changing the Herdr semantic that a token-stamped pane with no detected agent counts as live (PAN-3966)
- Putting Herdr work agents under the PTY supervisor or adding a new agent.started emitter
- Fixing God View shelf/Doldrums placement beyond verifying it; a persisting misplacement becomes a follow-up issue
- Changing tmux-host behavior (tmux panes already carry agentId = session name)
- Restarting or reloading the primary :3011 dashboard from the workspace

autoDecisions.summary: The primary fix is the agent-to-pane join key at six server sites, not only the event path the issue title names.
autoDecisions.rationale: Live evidence: /ws/rpc backendPanes already carried agentId from the list path, yet 14 live agents were absent from agentsById and GET /api/agents showed all stopped; both trace to `terminalId ?? id` joins. Fixing only the event path would leave the bug in place.

autoDecisions.summary: Shared helper lives in @overdeck/contracts with key agentId ?? terminalId ?? id.
autoDecisions.rationale: Server code already imports BackendPane from contracts; tmux panes always carry agentId and Herdr handles never equal agent ids, so the fallback is harmless and keeps existing tmux-shaped fixtures valid.

autoDecisions.summary: On a key collision the non-exited pane wins, never the reverse.
autoDecisions.rationale: A restarted Herdr agent can leave an exited pane with the same agentId token beside its live pane; last-wins Map construction could serve a live agent as stopped.

autoDecisions.summary: The enrichment census skip gate is in scope and follows the host backend policy.
autoDecisions.rationale: On a Herdr host with no tmux server the poller never runs, so no post-boot agent would ever get agent.created and issue AC 1 would stay false; the PAN-3055 'no evidence, no claims' rationale is preserved by using inventory degradation as Herdr's evidence.

autoDecisions.summary: herdr.ts edit is net-zero lines; allowlist row only as a fallback.
autoDecisions.rationale: src/lib/terminal-backends/herdr.ts is exactly at the 1000-line file-size ceiling.

autoDecisions.summary: Live verification (issue AC 4) runs on a peer dashboard on port 3497 started from the workspace build and killed by PID afterward.
autoDecisions.rationale: Only the flywheel deploys the primary :3011 dashboard; peer mode (OVERDECK_DISABLE_DEACON=1) is the supported read-only second dashboard and emits enrichment events in memory only.

autoDecisions.summary: The enrichment poller announces an agent only when its stored status is running or starting, in addition to having a live pane.
autoDecisions.rationale: On Herdr pan kill leaves the pane alive and agent.created hardcodes running over the stored row; without this gate the fix would serve every killed agent with a residue pane as running.

items.title: Add paneAgentKey and indexPanesByAgentKey to @overdeck/contracts

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1. Append two exported functions to packages/contracts/src/backend-pane.ts after `export type BackendPane`: paneAgentKey(pane) returns `pane.agentId ?? pane.terminalId ?? pane.id`; indexPanesByAgentKey(panes: Iterable<BackendPane>) returns Map<string, BackendPane> where a pane replaces a prior pane with the same key only when the prior is exited and the new one is not (first non-exited pane seen is kept). Use the exact code in the PRD, in the file's style (no semicolons). The file is already re-exported from packages/contracts/src/index.ts line 29. Create packages/contracts/src/__tests__/backend-pane.test.ts with Herdr-shaped fixtures (id 'wKZ:p3', terminalId 'term_65c8b78d3f05a5df', agentId 'agent-pan-4311').

When an exited pane and a live pane share one agentId, indexPanesByAgentKey returns the live pane for that key in both insertion orders

narrative.Action: PRD WI-3. In pollOnce() of src/dashboard/server/services/agent-enrichment-service.ts (lines 194-197) build livePaneIds from indexPanesByAgentKey(panes), keeping only keys whose pane is not exited, exactly as in the PRD after-snippet. Use Herdr-shaped panes and a distinct agent id per case because the service remembers announced ids per process. Never use real timers. ALSO (required, same item): change the activeAgents filter (line 208) to `runningAgents.filter(a => livePaneIds.has(a.id) && (a.status === 'running' || a.status === 'starting'))` with the PAN-4320 comment from the PRD. metadata.acJustification: Manual live check required by issue AC 4; no source edits are expected (files_scope names the verified route only).

narrative.Action: PRD WI-10. No source edits. After every code item is committed: npm run build; start `API_PORT=3497 OVERDECK_DISABLE_DEACON=1 node dist/dashboard/server.js > /tmp/pan-4320-peer.log 2>&1 &` from the workspace and record its PID; wait for /api/health 200 plus 20 s; run the PRD's /ws/rpc probe against :3497, `curl -s localhost:3497/api/agents`, and `herdr agent list`; open http://localhost:3497/god-view in an isolated Playwright browser profile and screenshot it; then `kill <pid>` and confirm nothing listens on 3497. Never restart, reload or signal the :3011 dashboard. Paste outputs and the screenshot into the PR description under 'Live verification (PAN-4320)'. If God View shelf/Doldrums misplacement persists, file a follow-up issue and link it; do not fix it here. The /ws/rpc probe cannot prove FR-3 on a freshly booted peer (it seeds agentsById at boot with every agent already stored running); FR-3 is proven by the enrichment-agent-key unit tests. If the flywheel happens to start an agent while the peer is up, re-probe and record that agent; never start an agent just for this check.
